input.description: A `Tensor`. dtype: A type for the returned `Tensor`. Must be `float16`, `float32`, `float64`, `int8`, `uint8`, `int16`, `uint16`, `int32`, `int64`, `complex64`, `complex128`, `bool` or `string`.

layout.description: Optional, `tf.experimental.dtensor.Layout`. If provided, the result is a [DTensor](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/dtensor_overview) with the provided layout.

output.description: A `Tensor` with all elements set to one.
